## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. **No `style="..."` attributes anywhere in the HTML.**
- All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors only.
- HTML remains clean, semantic, and style-agnostic — reskinning the site must require CSS edits only, never markup changes.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define all tokens in `:root` (light) and override under `.dark` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`:
- **Colors:** `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, plus `--accent-amber`, `--accent-info`, `--accent-premium`.
- **Contrast pairing:** enforced per Section 0 for both themes.
- **Light background:** `#F6FAF3` / `#FEFEFE` — never `#FFFFFF`.
- **Radius & shadows:** `--radius-sm` (8px), `--radius-md` (14px), `--radius-lg` (24px); `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (soft, diffuse, low-opacity — natural lighting, never harsh black shadows).
- **Spacing & transitions:** `--spacing-gap` (1.5rem), `--transition-fast` (150ms), `--transition-normal` (300ms), `--ease-standard` (organic curve, e.g., `cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.35, 1)`).
- **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown` (100), `--z-modal` (200), `--z-toast` (300).

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Dark mode tokens defined under **both** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on `<html>`/`<body>`.
- Theme switching swaps CSS variables only — no HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. The media-query tokens act as the no-JS base so there is no flash of the wrong theme.
- **Toggle control:** a visible sun/moon toggle in the header using a Google Material Symbol, with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode").

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities).
- **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified with a CSS comment. Permitted exceptions: `.input-group` and text-heavy card bodies use `align-items: flex-start` for reading flow.
- **Mobile-first:** multi-column rows (features, steps, pricing, testimonials) collapse to a single column below ~768px; no horizontal scrolling anywhere (fluid widths, `clamp()` typography, `overflow-x` guard). Breakpoints: ~640px, ~768px, ~1024px.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (CDN or build) or clean custom CSS organized with `@layer` / `@apply`. All utilities must map back to CSS variables, and component design must live in generic reusable classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Include Google Fonts `<link>` tags (serif headings + rounded sans body) and bind them to `--font-heading` / `--font-base`.
- Use **Google Material Symbols** (outlined, variable font) for every icon. **Explicitly forbidden: raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji icons.** (Exception for botanical artwork per Section 0 — CSS-built shapes only.)

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component (`.btn` + variants)**
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Variants: `.btn--primary` (forest/emerald fill), `.btn--secondary` (outline), `.btn--accent` (amber fill + dark text), `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger` (red — visually distinct in both themes).
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct ring via `outline` + `box-shadow` using `--secondary`; clearly visible in both themes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disables interactions and prevents double-clicks; renders a CSS border spinner or animated Material Symbol without changing button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback classes driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, always pairing an icon + text (never color alone).

**2.2 Card Component (`.card`)**
- **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary`, `--border-default`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover (interactive cards):** elevation shift to `--shadow-md` plus subtle `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- **Focus-within:** card border highlights in `--secondary` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (`.card--skeleton`):** shimmer keyframe animation that preserves layout dimensions.
- **Empty state:** structured fallback with a Google Icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements (`.input-group`)**
- **Structure:** flex container (column, `flex-start` exception) wrapping a `<label>`, the `<input>`, and a dedicated error feedback element.
- **States:** empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border + check icon), invalid (error border, error text + error icon), disabled, read-only.
- Apply to the Final CTA email capture: validate the email, show inline errors in an `aria-live` region, simulate submission with button loading → success state + toast.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
- Triggered by Final CTA / pricing buttons ("Get started").
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions.
- **UX:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`), dimmed backdrop, `--z-modal`, Google Icon close button (`aria-label="Close"`), keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` or overlay click, focus returns to the triggering element.

**2.5 Landing-Page-Specific Components**
- **Header:** sticky, translucent `--bg-primary` with backdrop blur; logo (eco icon + brand name), nav links with vine-like underline-grow hover/focus states, theme toggle, CTA button; mobile hamburger opens a dropdown panel (`--z-dropdown`) that is keyboard operable with `aria-expanded`.
- **Hero:** serif headline, subcopy, two CTAs; decorative botanical cluster arranged in a circular/wreath flow of Material Symbol leaves and flowers with staggered leaf-sway animation; organic blob background shapes with slow `border-radius` morphing; warm radial amber glow for soft, diffuse natural lighting.
- **Features:** 3 `.card` elements, each with a circular leaf-motif icon badge (emerald tint), title, and description; floral border reveal on scroll with staggered delays.
- **How It Works (infographic):** 3 steps in a flowing arrangement — numbered circular badges connected by organic curved connectors (CSS gradient vine lines); alternating alignment on desktop, vertical vine connector on mobile; reveals in natural flow order.
- **Testimonials:** 3 cards — quote, CSS initials avatar circle (or person Material Symbol), name, role, star rating (star icons plus `aria-label` such as "Rated 5 out of 5" — never color alone).
- **Pricing:** 3 tiers; middle tier highlighted with emerald border, elevated shadow, and amber "Most Popular" badge; feature lists with check icons; one CTA button per tier; premium tier may use `--accent-premium` accents.
- **FAQ:** accordion — each item is a `<button>` (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) plus a panel; chevron Material Symbol rotates; smooth height transition; fully keyboard operable.
- **Final CTA:** full-bleed section with curved organic `clip-path` edges, headline, and the email capture form (2.3) or a CTA that opens the modal (2.4).
- **Footer:** brand block, 2–3 secondary link columns, social icon links (Material Symbols with `aria-label`s), copyright line; every link has hover and `:focus-visible` states.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid sizing, `clamp()` typography, zero horizontal overflow at every breakpoint.
- **Smooth animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)` on all state changes. **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` must disable leaf sway, blob morphing, and scroll reveals** — all content remains fully visible with no motion.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** ≥ 4.5:1 text contrast in both Light and Dark modes; never rely on color alone to communicate state; semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`); correct ARIA roles/labels on the accordion, modal, theme toggle, and mobile dropdown; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions); `aria-live` regions for form errors, toasts, and loading feedback.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.
- **Scroll reveals:** `IntersectionObserver` adds `.is-visible` (opacity + translateY, staggered) — implemented as progressive enhancement so all content is visible without JavaScript.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- **File structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference to `script.js`; no inline styles; no inline event handlers (`addEventListener` only).
- **Naming convention:** BEM consistently across the entire deliverable (`.card`, `.card__title`, `.card--featured`, `.btn--primary`) — never mix conventions.
- **`script.js` responsibilities:** theme toggle + `localStorage` persistence, mobile navigation, FAQ accordion, modal with focus trap, form validation with loading/success states + toast, and IntersectionObserver reveals. No console errors; the page degrades gracefully without JavaScript.
- **No unrequested placeholders:** no lorem ipsum — write realistic English copy per Section 0 for every section; placeholders are permitted only where content was genuinely left unspecified.
- Generate the complete final code for all files immediately, on the first attempt.
